name: Hermes Agentplane
summary: Adds prompt policy for Agentplane-owned Hermes Kanban worker lanes.
description: Prompts agents and Hermes worker profiles to treat Hermes as dispatch/run lifecycle and Agentplane as engineering task truth, using route-gated execution, comment-first projection, and terminal evidence gates.

skills.summary: Keeps Hermes worker lanes route-gated and Agentplane-owned.

agents.summary: Supervises one Hermes claim by executing at most one allowlisted Agentplane route step.

scenarios.name: Dispatch Agentplane Task Through Hermes
scenarios.summary: Project an Agentplane task into Hermes Kanban and supervise it through the native Hermes adapter.
scenarios.description: Use this when a repository wants Hermes to own queueing, claims, retries, dashboard, and handoff while Agentplane remains the canonical owner of plan, worktree, verification, finish, and ACR evidence.
use_when: Hermes Kanban is the operational board for multi-agent work.
Agentplane branch_pr should protect concurrent repo work.
A worker lane must complete Hermes cards only after Agentplane terminal evidence validates.
avoid_when: The repository does not run Hermes Kanban.
The task is a single local direct-mode helper run.
The integration cannot provide Hermes lifecycle callbacks or a dispatcher lane.

prompt_modules.summary: Recipe-owned policy module for Hermes Agentplane worker lanes.

prompt_mutation_sets.summary: Registers Hermes Agentplane worker lane discipline in the managed prompt graph.
